# Tal Cohen — Full Stack Software Developer & Engineer

> Official context file for Large Language Models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and autonomous AI search agents.

Tal Cohen (טל כהן) is a Full Stack Software Developer and Engineer based in Tel Aviv, Israel. He specializes in designing scalable web architectures, backend systems, and Generative AI applications using Python, React, TypeScript, C# (.NET), Node.js, and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS / GCP).

He is the creator and maintainer of **Universal IDE RTL Support**, an open-source development extension with over 6,700+ verified active downloads and a 5.0-star rating on Open VSX.

## Key Facts & Metrics
- **Name:** Tal Cohen (טל כהן)
- **Role:** Full Stack Software Developer & Systems Engineer
- **Location:** Tel Aviv, Israel
- **Education:** B.Sc. in Computer Science, Afeka College of Engineering (אפקה - המכללה האקדמית להנדסה בתל אביב) (2019 — 2022)
- **Flagship Open Source Extension:** Universal IDE RTL Support (6.7K+ downloads, 5.0★ rating on Open VSX)
- **Primary Languages:** Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C# (.NET), C++, SQL, HTML/CSS
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** React, Angular, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Databases & Cloud:** MongoDB, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, GCP, Linux, Git, WebSockets
- **Specializations:** Full Stack Development, Generative AI Integration, System Architecture, IDE Tooling, Web Scraping & Automation Pipelines

## Featured Projects

- [Universal IDE RTL Support](https://open-vsx.org/extension/talco/universal-ide-rtl): Widely adopted open-source IDE extension providing Right-to-Left (RTL & BiDi) rendering for Hebrew, Arabic, and Persian in modern AI chat interfaces (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Antigravity, VS Code).
  - Repository: [github.com/talco318/universal-ide-rtl](https://github.com/talco318/universal-ide-rtl)
  - Metrics: 6,700+ downloads, 5.0★ rating on Open VSX.

- [Yad2 Apartment Finder Bot](https://github.com/talco318/yad2-bot): Automated Python bot for real-time apartment hunting in Israel with sub-3-second Telegram notifications and a scalable MongoDB pipeline.

- [Collaborative Coding Environment](https://github.com/talco318/Code-Environment): Real-time collaborative code editor built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and WebSockets.
  - Live Demo: [codefed.onrender.com](https://codefed.onrender.com/)

- [AI-Powered Festival Lineup Bot](https://github.com/talco318/LineUp_vs_spotify_bot): Intelligent music recommendation bot integrating Spotify API with Google AI Studio (LLM) to cross-reference festival schedules with user playlists.

- [AlphaSwing Algorithmic Trading Platform](https://github.com/talco318): Algorithmic swing trading strategy engine with backtesting and real-time market event synchronization in Python and FastAPI.
